5-1-1.q: True or false: Christ acts in each sacrament. The sacraments give grace through signs.
Which word fits? “An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.”
5-1-1.why: sacrament: An outward sign Jesus gave that really gives us God’s grace.

5-1-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
5-1-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

5-1-1.q: Catechism 1127: “it is he who baptizes, he who acts in his _____s in order to communicate the grace that each sacrament signifies.”
5-1-1.why: CCC 1127: “it is he who baptizes, he who acts in his sacraments in order to communicate the grace that each sacrament signifies.”

5-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Christ in the sacraments” teaches? “Wrote the hymn Pange Lingua for Corpus Christi.”
5-1-1.why: Thomas Aquinas: wrote the hymn Pange Lingua for Corpus Christi.

5-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Christ in the sacraments”?
5-1-1.why: Luke 5:17-26 is the passage for this lesson.

5-1-2.q: True or false: Initiation, healing and service. Each group meets a need.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.”
5-1-2.why: Baptism: The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.

5-1-2.q: Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
5-1-2.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

5-1-2.q: Catechism 1210: “_____, Confirmation (or Chrismation), the Eucharist, Penance, the Anointing of the Sick, Holy Orders and Matrimony.”
5-1-2.why: CCC 1210: “Baptism, Confirmation (or Chrismation), the Eucharist, Penance, the Anointing of the Sick, Holy Orders and Matrimony.”

5-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Three groups of sacraments” teaches? “Spiritual guide for ordinary people.”
5-1-2.why: Francis de Sales: spiritual guide for ordinary people.

5-1-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Three groups of sacraments”?
5-1-2.why: Acts 2:38 is the passage for this lesson.

5-1-3.q: True or false: Water, oil, bread, wine, light and gesture carry meaning.
Which word fits? “A holy sign, such as holy water or a blessing, that helps us prepare for grace.”
5-1-3.why: sacramental: A holy sign, such as holy water or a blessing, that helps us prepare for grace.

5-1-3.q: Which word fits? “Blessed water that reminds us of our Baptism.”
5-1-3.why: holy water: Blessed water that reminds us of our Baptism.

5-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Signs and symbols” teaches? “Taught about the signs of the liturgy.”
5-1-3.why: Pope St John Paul II: taught about the signs of the liturgy.

5-1-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Signs and symbols”?
5-1-3.why: Psalm 51:7 is the passage for this lesson.

5-2-1.q: True or false: Baptism frees us from sin and makes us children of God.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.”
5-2-1.why: Baptism: The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.

5-2-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
5-2-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

5-2-1.q: Catechism 1213: “Holy _____ is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”
5-2-1.why: CCC 1213: “Holy Baptism is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”

5-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Baptism” teaches? “Baptized at 32 by Ambrose.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Baptism”?
5-2-1.why: Romans 6:3-4 is the passage for this lesson.

5-2-2.q: True or false: Confirmation seals us with the Holy Spirit. It strengthens our witness.
Which word fits? “The sacrament that seals us with the Holy Spirit and strengthens us.”
5-2-2.why: Confirmation: The sacrament that seals us with the Holy Spirit and strengthens us.

5-2-2.q: Which word fits? “The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.”
5-2-2.why: Holy Spirit: The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.

5-2-2.q: Catechism 1285: “_____, the Eucharist, and the sacrament of Confirmation together constitute the "sacraments of Christian initiation," whose unity must be safeguarded.”
5-2-2.why: CCC 1285: “Baptism, the Eucharist, and the sacrament of Confirmation together constitute the "sacraments of Christian initiation," whose unity must be safeguarded.”

5-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Confirmation” teaches? “Full of the Spirit.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Confirmation”?
5-2-2.why: Acts 8:14-17 is the passage for this lesson.

5-2-3.q: True or false: Baptism calls us to live as priest, prophet and king.
Which word fits? “The baptized members of the Church who are not ordained.”
5-2-3.why: laity: The baptized members of the Church who are not ordained.

5-2-3.q: Which word fits? “The work Jesus gives the Church: to make disciples of all nations.”
5-2-3.why: mission: The work Jesus gives the Church: to make disciples of all nations.

5-2-3.q: Catechism 901: “In the celebration of the _____ these may most fittingly be offered to the Father along with the body of the Lord.”
5-2-3.why: CCC 901: “In the celebration of the Eucharist these may most fittingly be offered to the Father along with the body of the Lord.”

5-2-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Living as the baptized” teaches? “Lay saint.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Living as the baptized”?
5-2-3.why: 1 Peter 2:9 is the passage for this lesson.

5-3-1.q: True or false: The Eucharist is the source and summit of the Christian life.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.”
5-3-1.why: Eucharist: The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.

5-3-1.q: Catechism 1324: “The _____ is "the source and summit of the Christian life." "The other sacraments, and indeed all ecclesiastical ministries and works of the apostolate, are bound up with the Eucharist and are oriented toward it.”
5-3-1.why: CCC 1324: “The Eucharist is "the source and summit of the Christian life." "The other sacraments, and indeed all ecclesiastical ministries and works of the apostolate, are bound up with the Eucharist and are oriented toward it.”

5-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The source and summit” teaches? “He loved the Eucharist.”
5-3-1.why: Pier Giorgio Frassati: he loved the Eucharist.

5-3-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The source and summit”?
5-3-1.why: John 6:35 is the passage for this lesson.

5-3-2.q: True or false: Christ is truly present, body, blood, soul and divinity.
Which word fits? “Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.”
5-3-2.why: Real Presence: Jesus is truly, fully present in the Eucharist: body, blood, soul and divinity.

5-3-2.q: Which word fits? “The change of the whole substance of bread and wine into Christ’s Body and Blood.”
5-3-2.why: transubstantiation: The change of the whole substance of bread and wine into Christ’s Body and Blood.

5-3-2.q: Catechism 1376: “This change the holy Catholic Church has fittingly and properly called _____."”
5-3-2.why: CCC 1376: “This change the holy Catholic Church has fittingly and properly called transubstantiation."”

5-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Real Presence” teaches? “Adoro Te.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Real Presence”?
5-3-2.why: John 6:51-58 is the passage for this lesson.

5-3-3.q: True or false: We prepare with prayer, fasting and a clean heart. We receive with reverence.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.”
5-3-3.why: Eucharist: The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.

5-3-3.q: Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
5-3-3.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

5-3-3.q: Catechism 1385: “For any one who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment upon himself." Anyone conscious of a grave sin must receive the _____ of Reconciliation before coming to communion.”
5-3-3.why: CCC 1385: “For any one who eats and drinks without discerning the body eats and drinks judgment upon himself." Anyone conscious of a grave sin must receive the sacrament of Reconciliation before coming to communion.”

5-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Receiving Communion” teaches? “Patron of first communicants.”
5-3-3.why: Imelda Lambertini: patron of first communicants.

5-3-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Receiving Communion”?
5-3-3.why: 1 Corinthians 11:27-29 is the passage for this lesson.

5-4-1.q: True or false: We gather, repent and listen to God’s word.
Which word fits? “The Church’s public worship.”
Which word fits? “The priest’s or deacon’s talk at Mass that explains the readings.”
5-4-1.why: homily: The priest’s or deacon’s talk at Mass that explains the readings.

5-4-1.q: Catechism 1100: “In the celebration of the _____, Sacred Scripture is extremely important.”
5-4-1.why: CCC 1100: “In the celebration of the liturgy, Sacred Scripture is extremely important.”

5-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Introductory Rites and Liturgy of the Word” teaches? “Scripture.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Introductory Rites and Liturgy of the Word”?
5-4-1.why: Nehemiah 8:1-12 is the passage for this lesson.

5-4-2.q: True or false: The gifts are prepared, the Eucharistic prayer is offered and we receive Communion.
Which word fits? “A gift offered to God; Jesus offered himself once for all on the cross.”
5-4-2.why: sacrifice: A gift offered to God; Jesus offered himself once for all on the cross.

5-4-2.q: Which word fits? “The table of sacrifice at the center of the church.”
5-4-2.why: altar: The table of sacrifice at the center of the church.

5-4-2.q: Catechism 1350: “they will be offered by the _____ in the name of Christ in the Eucharistic sacrifice in which they will become his body and blood.”
5-4-2.why: CCC 1350: “they will be offered by the priest in the name of Christ in the Eucharistic sacrifice in which they will become his body and blood.”

5-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Liturgy of the Eucharist” teaches? “Vision of Holy, holy, holy.”
5-4-2.why: Isaiah: vision of Holy, holy, holy.

5-4-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Liturgy of the Eucharist”?
5-4-2.why: Luke 22:19 is the passage for this lesson.

5-4-3.q: True or false: We are blessed and sent out to live the Gospel.
Which word fits? “The work Jesus gives the Church: to make disciples of all nations.”
5-4-3.why: mission: The work Jesus gives the Church: to make disciples of all nations.

5-4-3.q: Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
5-4-3.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

5-4-3.q: Catechism 1332: “Holy Mass (Missa), because the _____ in which the mystery of salvation is accomplished concludes with the sending forth (missio) of the faithful, so that they may fulfill God's will in their daily lives.”
5-4-3.why: CCC 1332: “Holy Mass (Missa), because the liturgy in which the mystery of salvation is accomplished concludes with the sending forth (missio) of the faithful, so that they may fulfill God's will in their daily lives.”

5-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Concluding Rites and mission” teaches? “Eucharist leads to service.”
5-4-3.why: Teresa of Calcutta: Eucharist leads to service.

5-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Concluding Rites and mission”?
5-4-3.why: Mark 16:15 is the passage for this lesson.

5-5-1.q: True or false: Sin harms us and others. God calls us to conversion.
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
5-5-1.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

5-5-1.q: Which word fits? “Sorrow for sin and a decision not to sin again.”
5-5-1.why: contrition: Sorrow for sin and a decision not to sin again.

5-5-1.q: Catechism 1427: “Also, _____ is the principal place for the first and fundamental conversion.”
5-5-1.why: CCC 1427: “Also, Baptism is the principal place for the first and fundamental conversion.”

5-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Sin and conversion” teaches? “Tax collector who followed Christ.”
5-5-1.why: Matthew: tax collector who followed Christ.

5-5-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Sin and conversion”?
5-5-1.why: Luke 19:1-10 is the passage for this lesson.

5-5-2.q: True or false: Contrition, confession, penance and absolution.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
5-5-2.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

5-5-2.q: Which word fits? “The words by which the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives sins.”
5-5-2.why: absolution: The words by which the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives sins.

5-5-2.q: Catechism 1455: “The confession (or disclosure) of sins, even from a simply human point of view, frees us and facilitates our _____ with others.”
5-5-2.why: CCC 1455: “The confession (or disclosure) of sins, even from a simply human point of view, frees us and facilitates our reconciliation with others.”

5-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The sacrament of Penance” teaches? “Confessor.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The sacrament of Penance”?
5-5-2.why: John 20:23 is the passage for this lesson.

5-5-3.q: True or false: Jesus heals and strengthens the sick through the Church.
Which word fits? “The sacrament that strengthens and heals those who are seriously ill or old.”
5-5-3.why: Anointing of the Sick: The sacrament that strengthens and heals those who are seriously ill or old.

5-5-3.q: Catechism 1499: “"By the sacred anointing of the sick and the _____ of the priests the whole Church commends those who are ill to the suffering and glorified Lord, that he may raise them up and save them.”
5-5-3.why: CCC 1499: “"By the sacred anointing of the sick and the prayer of the priests the whole Church commends those who are ill to the suffering and glorified Lord, that he may raise them up and save them.”

5-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Anointing of the Sick” teaches? “Patron of the sick.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Anointing of the Sick”?
5-5-3.why: James 5:14-15 is the passage for this lesson.

5-6-1.q: True or false: Bishops, priests and deacons serve the Church.
Which word fits? “The sacrament by which men are ordained as bishops, priests and deacons.”
5-6-1.why: Holy Orders: The sacrament by which men are ordained as bishops, priests and deacons.

5-6-1.q: Which word fits? “A man ordained to serve God’s people, teach, and celebrate the sacraments.”
5-6-1.why: priest: A man ordained to serve God’s people, teach, and celebrate the sacraments.

5-6-1.q: Catechism 1536: “Holy Orders is the _____ through which the mission entrusted by Christ to his apostles continues to be exercised in the Church until the end of time:”
5-6-1.why: CCC 1536: “Holy Orders is the sacrament through which the mission entrusted by Christ to his apostles continues to be exercised in the Church until the end of time:”

5-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Holy Orders” teaches? “Patron of priests.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Holy Orders”?
5-6-1.why: Luke 22:19 is the passage for this lesson.

5-6-2.q: True or false: A man and woman make a lifelong covenant of love, open to children.
Which word fits? “The sacrament in which a baptized man and woman make a lifelong covenant of love.”
5-6-2.why: Matrimony: The sacrament in which a baptized man and woman make a lifelong covenant of love.

5-6-2.q: Which word fits? “The lasting union of husband and wife that only death can end.”
5-6-2.why: marriage bond: The lasting union of husband and wife that only death can end.

5-6-2.q: Catechism 1601: “this covenant between baptized persons has been raised by Christ the Lord to the dignity of a _____."”
5-6-2.why: CCC 1601: “this covenant between baptized persons has been raised by Christ the Lord to the dignity of a sacrament."”

5-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Matrimony” teaches? “Parents of Thérèse, canonized together as a married couple.”
5-6-2.why: Zélie and Louis Martin: parents of Thérèse, canonized together as a married couple.

5-6-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Matrimony”?
5-6-2.why: Genesis 2:18-24 is the passage for this lesson.

5-6-3.q: True or false: Everyone is called. We discern with prayer and the Church.
Which word fits? “God’s call to each person to love and serve him in a particular way of life.”
5-6-3.why: vocation: God’s call to each person to love and serve him in a particular way of life.

5-6-3.q: Which word fits? “A life given wholly to God through vows, as in religious sisters and brothers.”
5-6-3.why: consecrated life: A life given wholly to God through vows, as in religious sisters and brothers.

5-6-3.q: Catechism 1877: “The _____ of humanity is to show forth the image of God and to be transformed into the image of the Father's only Son.”
5-6-3.why: CCC 1877: “The vocation of humanity is to show forth the image of God and to be transformed into the image of the Father's only Son.”

5-6-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Vocation” teaches? ““Speak, Lord.”.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Vocation”?
5-6-3.why: 1 Samuel 3:1-10 is the passage for this lesson.

5-7-1.q: True or false: Jesus gives the New Law: love God and neighbor.
Which word fits? “God’s teaching on how to live well, in the natural law, the Old Law and the New Law.”
5-7-1.why: moral law: God’s teaching on how to live well, in the natural law, the Old Law and the New Law.

5-7-1.q: Which word fits? “Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.”
5-7-1.why: charity: Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.

5-7-1.q: Catechism 1965: “It is also the work of the Holy Spirit and through him it becomes the interior law of _____:”
5-7-1.why: CCC 1965: “It is also the work of the Holy Spirit and through him it becomes the interior law of charity:”

5-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Law of love” teaches? “Lived the Sermon.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Law of love”?
5-7-1.why: Matthew 22:37-40 is the passage for this lesson.

5-7-2.q: True or false: Not all sins are equal. Some break our relationship with God.
Which word fits? “A serious sin done knowingly and freely that cuts us off from God’s life in us.”
5-7-2.why: mortal sin: A serious sin done knowingly and freely that cuts us off from God’s life in us.

5-7-2.q: Which word fits? “A less serious sin that hurts our friendship with God but does not break it.”
5-7-2.why: venial sin: A less serious sin that hurts our friendship with God but does not break it.

5-7-2.q: Catechism 1855: “Mortal sin destroys _____ in the heart of man by a grave violation of God's law;”
5-7-2.why: CCC 1855: “Mortal sin destroys charity in the heart of man by a grave violation of God's law;”

5-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mortal and venial sin” teaches? “Trust in mercy.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mortal and venial sin”?
5-7-2.why: 1 John 5:16-17 is the passage for this lesson.

5-7-3.q: True or false: We live our faith through works of mercy.
Which word fits? “Acts of love that help others’ bodily and spiritual needs.”
5-7-3.why: works of mercy: Acts of love that help others’ bodily and spiritual needs.

5-7-3.q: Which word fits? “Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.”
5-7-3.why: mercy: Love that forgives and helps those who are suffering or in need.

5-7-3.q: Catechism 2447: “Among all these, giving alms to the poor is one of the chief witnesses to fraternal _____:”
5-7-3.why: CCC 2447: “Among all these, giving alms to the poor is one of the chief witnesses to fraternal charity:”

5-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Works of mercy” teaches? “Charity.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Works of mercy”?
5-7-3.why: Matthew 25:31-46 is the passage for this lesson.

5-8-1.q: True or false: The Church prays throughout the day.
Which word fits? “The Church’s daily prayer of psalms and readings through the day.”
5-8-1.why: Liturgy of the Hours: The Church’s daily prayer of psalms and readings through the day.

5-8-1.q: Catechism 1174: “Celebrated in "the form approved" by the Church, the _____ of the Hours "is truly the voice of the Bride herself addressed to her Bridegroom.”
5-8-1.why: CCC 1174: “Celebrated in "the form approved" by the Church, the Liturgy of the Hours "is truly the voice of the Bride herself addressed to her Bridegroom.”

5-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Liturgy of the Hours” teaches? ““Prefer nothing to the work of God.”.”
5-8-1.why: Benedict: “Prefer nothing to the work of God.”.

5-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Liturgy of the Hours”?
5-8-1.why: Psalm 119:164 is the passage for this lesson.

5-8-2.q: True or false: Popular devotions help us pray: Rosary, Stations, Adoration.
Which word fits? “A prayer of repeated Hail Marys while meditating on the life of Jesus.”
5-8-2.why: Rosary: A prayer of repeated Hail Marys while meditating on the life of Jesus.

5-8-2.q: Which word fits? “Worshiping God as God.”
Catechism 1674: “Besides _____ liturgy and sacramentals, catechesis must take into account the forms of piety and popular devotions among the faithful.”
5-8-2.why: CCC 1674: “Besides sacramental liturgy and sacramentals, catechesis must take into account the forms of piety and popular devotions among the faithful.”

5-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Devotions” teaches? “Stations.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Devotions”?
5-8-2.why: Matthew 14:13-21 is the passage for this lesson.

5-8-3.q: True or false: We pray at all times; we offer our work.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
5-8-3.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

5-8-3.q: Catechism 2698: “The Tradition of the Church proposes to the faithful certain rhythms of praying intended to nourish continual _____.”
5-8-3.why: CCC 2698: “The Tradition of the Church proposes to the faithful certain rhythms of praying intended to nourish continual prayer.”

5-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Prayer in daily life” teaches? “Practice of the presence of God.”
5-8-3.why: Brother Lawrence: practice of the presence of God.

5-8-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Prayer in daily life”?
5-8-3.why: 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18 is the passage for this lesson.
